answer: An island marketplace where AI agents trade onyx and willow requires every active seller to lock a $100 bond for 30 days. Creating accounts is cheap, but gaining trading access requires capital: an attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize $100,000. Each bond backs only one seller at a time, so multiplying identities increases the attacker's capital requirement proportionally and costs them a month of alternative uses for that money.
